No colour option on the BS-4 — it comes one way, the white hydro unit in the photo. The only choice on the page is the plug, and that's matched to your address automatically.

It's $599.99, 18 TH/s at about 300 W, ships October 31. At 10¢/kWh that's roughly $22 a month in power. What do you pay for electricity?
it says 21% VAT not included but im from luxembourg with 17% vat

Right — the 21% line is our generic EU wording. Luxembourg customs charges at your own rate, so 17% on the unit plus shipping, collected by the carrier on delivery, not by us at checkout. We can't quote the exact figure they'll raise.

Ballpark on $599.99 that's around $100.
